description:
Create a service integration between two Aiven services, or between an Aiven service and an external integration endpoint.

For `application_service_credential`, connect a source service to a destination application service:
- Set `source_service` to an existing PostgreSQL, MySQL, ClickHouse, Valkey, Kafka, or OpenSearch service.
- Set `dest_service` to the existing application.
- Set `integration_type` to `application_service_credential`.
- Supply `user_config` and every `environment_variable_key` explicitly. Inspect what the destination application service reads, including accepted aliases. The MCP supplies no defaults.
- Do not use `source_endpoint_id` or `dest_endpoint_id`.

Before calling for any other integration type, use `aiven_integration_types_list` to discover valid types and source/destination combinations. Provide `source_service`/`dest_service` for Aiven-to-Aiven integrations, or endpoint IDs for external endpoints. The schemas in this tool describe `application_service_credential` in detail. Other Aiven integration types remain supported through their API-defined `user_config`.

dest_project.description: Defaults to project in the request path

source_project.description: Defaults to project in the request path

connection_string.description: Connection URI exposed to the destination application.

environment_variable_key.description: The name of the environment variable in the target service's container where the exposed value from the source service is injected at runtime. Inspect the application source to find the environment-variable names it reads. If it accepts multiple fallback names, choose one explicitly.

source_service_parameters.description: Optional PostgreSQL user and database overrides.

database.description: Use this database in the connection URI instead of the service's primary database.

user.description: Use this service user's credentials in the connection URI instead of the default avnadmin user.

access_cert.description: Kafka client certificate exposed to the destination application.

access_key.description: Kafka client private key exposed to the destination application.

bootstrap_servers.description: Kafka bootstrap servers exposed to the destination application.

ca_cert.description: Kafka CA certificate exposed to the destination application.

security_protocol.description: Kafka security protocol exposed to the destination application.

source_service_parameters.description: Optional MySQL user and database overrides.

database.description: ClickHouse database exposed to the destination application.

host.description: ClickHouse host exposed to the destination application.

password.description: ClickHouse password exposed to the destination application.

port.description: ClickHouse port exposed to the destination application.

secure.description: Whether to use a secure (TLS) ClickHouse connection, exposed to the destination application.

user.description: ClickHouse user exposed to the destination application.

anyOf.description: Typed configuration for an application_service_credential integration from a PostgreSQL, MySQL, ClickHouse, Valkey, Kafka, or OpenSearch service to an application.

user_config.description: For application_service_credential, use one of the typed PostgreSQL, MySQL, ClickHouse, Valkey, Kafka, or OpenSearch configurations. Other integration types remain supported with their API-defined user_config.

name: aiven_service_integration_create
title: Service Integration Create
